claim: Swiss voters reject the 'Fairness' initiative on federal taxation of married couples.

runs.scenario: If the vote is held on 29 November but the official provisional result showing rejection is first published after the 23:59 Zurich cutoff, one reader could resolve YES because the vote took place within the window, while another could resolve NO because they read the window as also requiring publication of the result.
runs.yes_requires: The vote on the named initiative is held on 29 November 2026 in Europe/Zurich, and the official provisional result shows that national YES votes do not exceed NO votes or that cantonal votes in favour do not exceed 11.5 out of 23. Either failure is enough.
